annotations.title: What are people saying under this video?

description: Use when the user wants to know what viewers raise under a trailer, launch video, ad or review on YouTube, for example whether they talk about price, a feature or a complaint. Returns, for up to eight themes named in advance, the count and share of up to 400 top comments per video (up to five videos) that mention each, with how many comments were read. No comment text. Safe to cite: its controls are checked first, it states its limits, and every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. If a control fails it refuses and you are not charged. This tool charges nothing: it validates the request and returns a payment_url, the price and instructions. Pay by POSTing to payment_url over MPP (HTTP 402, a Stripe shared payment token from your wallet). Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. To have a sound result considered for publication on cultmath.com, add publish: true and question (what you were asked) to the POST body, and credit_name to be credited; CULT+MATH reviews every submission first, and a published piece earns one free run.

themes.description: 1-8 words or short phrases to count, comma-separated, e.g. "disc,price,story".

videos.description: 1-5 YouTube video IDs (the 11 characters after v= in the link), comma-separated.
